settings.label: Show compare-at price
settings.info: Struck through only when it is higher than the price. Enter a compare-at price only if the product really sold at it; Anvil has no manual savings field.

settings.label: Savings badge
settings.info: Computed from the compare-at price, so it only appears when there is a real saving. Theme default follows Theme settings > Badges.

settings.label: Show unit price
settings.info: Appears for variants that have a unit price measurement in the admin.

settings.label: Show tax and shipping note
settings.info: Says whether tax is included for the shopper's market and that shipping is calculated at checkout, linking your shipping policy when you have one.
